summary: Phase H validation (Adzuna + Jooble + EURES + admin sources card). 11/11 backend pytest passed. Adzuna returns 100 real French offers, Jooble=0 (known 403 from upstream — key not yet activated), EURES=0 (APIFY_TOKEN empty as expected). /api/external-offers/all merges keyless+keyed = 222 offers (Arbeitnow 47, Remotive 10, RemoteOK 12, Jobicy 5, Ashby 48, Adzuna 100) with 0 duplicates. Cache hit on 2nd call works. Admin endpoints (/admin/external-sources-status, /admin/external-offers-cache) listed all 11 sources, protected (401 anon). Phase F/G re-validated: 33 diploma levels, no is_demo offers, anonymous AI search 200. Frontend: AISearchBar visible & functional on Landing as anonymous; /offers shows 268 offers with Adzuna/Arbeitnow/Remotive/RemoteOK/Jobicy/Ashby/FranceTravail/StageEtudiant cards each tagged 'ORIGINE : XXX'; source filter dropdown contains all 13 sources (Adzuna, Jooble, EURES included); diploma level select has 33 real levels + 1 placeholder; /admin shows new 'Sources API d'offres' card with refresh-sources and purge-external-offers buttons (clickable).

action_items: Optional: contact Jooble support to activate the API key (currently 403). Frontend already lists Jooble in source filter — when activated, no code change needed.
Optional: provide APIFY_TOKEN to enable EURES scraper (currently silently skipped as designed).

critical_code_review_comments: OffersPage has TWO instances of [data-testid=filter-source] (desktop + mobile filter columns). Consider differentiating data-testid (e.g., filter-source-desktop / filter-source-mobile) or hiding via display:none in DOM to avoid Playwright resolving 2 elements.
external_keyed.fetch_adzuna: free Adzuna tier is 250 calls/month — the 12h cache TTL is appropriate, but consider increasing TTL to 24h for keyed sources to better absorb traffic.
Admin /external-sources-status loops over 11 sources and does 2 Mongo queries per source (22 queries serial). Acceptable for low-frequency admin call but could be aggregated via $group for scale.
